topic: Inventory page image management and map logic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on implementing full image management logic for the inventory page, specifically within the facility data structure. The current API has been updated to handle facility data, which includes an array of images.

**Image Management:** [p1] requested implementation of functionality to add new images (including a temporary server stub method that simulates file upload and returns a fake URL), sort existing images, and remove images. This logic must save the changes back to the facility record. The actual S3 upload process is deferred.

**Map Logic:** [p1] noted that the map functionality currently only supports Asset types but needs to be updated to handle other entity types present on the page.

**UI/UX Fixes:** A separate UI issue was reported regarding the 'edit' button on the sandbox analytics inventory page, which is positioned off-screen and difficult to access on standard devices.
decisions: Implement full image management (add, sort, remove) logic for facility data.
action_items: [p2] needs to implement the image adding/removing/sorting logic using the provided API structure.
[p2] needs to update the map logic to support entity types beyond just Asset types.
[p2] needs to correct the positioning of the 'edit' button on the sandbox analytics inventory page.
